summary: The milestone completed 7 experiments in 15.7 minutes. Three-family self-commitment shortcut controls took 15.54 minutes and formed the critical path. Authority-only mutation sidecar and blinded learner view took 0.01 minutes, while V613 source delta and task-contract preflight took 0.0 minutes; the supplied timing does not identify the cause of these durations.
bottlenecks_identified: Three-family self-commitment shortcut controls used 15.54 of the 15.7 minutes, which concentrated the milestone wall time in one compute-bound task.
Disk-mtime reconstruction has no phase-level timing, so the cause of the longest experiment cannot be identified.
The GPU report is not linked to task execution windows, so it cannot measure utilization across the compute-bound work.
No model-count or runner-selection data is available, so a missed DualGPURunner dispatch cannot be identified.
improvements_suggested: Record phase-level durations for each compute-bound experiment.
Capture task-linked GPU utilization throughout each compute-bound execution window.
Write a launch receipt with model count and runner selection, and use DualGPURunner only when 2 or more models load in parallel.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Add phase timers to the Three-family self-commitment shortcut controls path.
Add task-linked GPU activity receipts for compute-bound runs.
Add model-count and runner-selection fields to launch receipts.
meta_reflection: The reconstructed timing identifies the critical path but does not explain its internal cost. No measured alternative is available, so the time-savings estimate remains 0%.
